**Checklist · قبل ما ترسل**
- [ ] The pull request targets **`next`**, not `master` · الطلب على `next`
- [ ] I ran `bash tests/run.sh` (or the test of the file I touched) and it passed · شغّلت الاختبارات ونجحت
- [ ] No test was skipped or disabled to make it pass · ما عطّلت أي اختبار
- [ ] No personal data (IP, serial, Wi-Fi name, user name, file path) and no font files · بدون معلومات شخصية ولا خطوط
